links.outcome: AI chest X-ray accuracy, sensitivity and specificity against radiologist reference on local primary care images
links.effect: Accuracy 0.95 (95% CI 0.92; 0.98), sensitivity 0.48 (95% CI 0.30; 0.66), specificity 0.98 (95% CI 0.97; 0.99); low sensitivity for mediastinum, vessels and bone conditions.
links.quote: Analysing the validity of the AI algorithm, the average accuracy was 0.95 (95% CI 0.92; 0.98), the sensitivity was 0.48 (95% CI 0.30; 0.66) and the specificity was 0.98 (95% CI 0.97; 0.99).

screen.reason: Prospective observational external validation study of an AI algorithm for chest X-ray interpretation in real primary care clinical practice, measuring diagnostic accuracy against radiologist ground truth.
